test_title: PYST 4: SSC CGL 2025 Tier-I Similar Paper - English (Held On: 13th Sep 2025 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Choose the best replacement for the highlighted part:

I suggested that he __goes to the doctor immediately.__

options.text: should have go to the doctor

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• After verbs like **suggest, recommend, insist, demand**, English uses the **subjunctive mood**.
 
• In the subjunctive form, the verb appears in the **base form** (V1) without **-s**, even for third-person singular.
 
• The highlighted phrase **“goes to the doctor”** is incorrect because it violates the subjunctive rule.
 
• The grammatically correct form is **“go to the doctor immediately.”**

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *“I suggested that he **go to the doctor immediately**.”*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1:** “go to doctor at once” – Missing article **the**, so grammatically incomplete.
 
• **Option 2:** “should goes to the doctor” – Wrong verb form; “should” must be followed by base verb (**go**).
 
• **Option 4:** “should have go to the doctor” – Incorrect structure; correct form would be “should have gone.”
